findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed manifest's evidence_inputs cite recovery.py:1358,1365 as where the unknown/unknown row is rendered, but those lines are inside _ordered_review_lanes; the renderer format_watch_transition is at recovery.py:8271, so a reader following the citation reaches an unrelated function.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest records that test_ticker_emits_only_changes_and_ends_after_the_last_promotion fails in BOTH arms (a pre-existing fleet_transitions product defect: it pops a promoted run from running memory while _promote_record_holds keeps its live pointer promoted), which is outside this node's change and belongs to whichever node owns that defect.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit 67beff6a against base 70d735ac; two guards both keyed on session is None, one at _follow_resume_plan and one at _record_checkpoint; the read path has this one production caller and follow_checkpoint.write has this one production caller, so a session-less follower has no remaining path that reads or writes a durable place.
item_verdicts.done_when: the named test tests/test_crew_monitor_output.py::test_three_followers_receive_each_subsequent_transition_once drives three concurrent session-less followers; independently reproduced at head 5/5 green and at base 7/10 red with the leading '--:--:-- ... unknown ... unknown' row, matching the reviewed run's own head 20/20 vs base 13/20 (logs/review-gate.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a third concurrent session-less fleet follower must not emit a resume event the watch pane renders as an unknown/unknown row; reckon/cli.py:2498-2503 makes _follow_resume_plan return ("baseline", 0, {}) for session is None before any checkpoint read, and reckon/cli.py:2878-2882 makes _record_checkpoint return before writing, so a session-less follower neither reads a peer's place nor leaves one.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commit 67beff6a, the head gate (20/20 green), the base arm (13/20 red), a negative-control log (5 of 6 red), the added-failure figures, and a landing line; its evidence_inputs cite the renderer locus as recovery.py:1358,1365, which is inside _ordered_review_lanes rather than the renderer.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff 70d735ac..67beff6a touches exactly one file, reckon/cli.py, 12 insertions and 0 deletions, both hunks inside the declared write path reckon/cli.py, and no test file is edited.

justifications.durability: removing the two guards reproduces the failure, so the guard is load-bearing rather than untestable: base 70d735ac and the declared mutation both redden tests/test_crew_monitor_output.py::test_three_followers_receive_each_subsequent_transition_once, and the caller at reckon/cli.py:3082 passes the session the guard reads.
justifications.evidence: the base arm (logs/base-monitor.log, revision 70d735ac, 13/20 red) and head arm (logs/head-monitor-loop.log, revision 67beff6a, 20/20 green) are recorded and independently reproduced at logs/review-gate.log (head 5/5, base 7/10), and the negative control (logs/negative-control.log, EXIT=1) reddens the named id; the manifest's cited renderer lines recovery.py:1358,1365 do not resolve to the renderer, which sits at recovery.py:8271.
justifications.fit: the early returns are idiomatic for this file and reuse the existing rule that a session-less follower keeps no history (reckon/cli.py:3699 withholds history caps when session is None), but the change disables durable checkpoints for every present and future session-less follower rather than keying the checkpoint per follower, which is a broader instrument than the defect strictly needs.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/cli.py:2498-2503 short-circuits _follow_resume_plan to baseline before follow_checkpoint.read when session is None, and reckon/cli.py:2878-2882 short-circuits _record_checkpoint before follow_checkpoint.write, which is the exact mechanism (two session-less followers sharing one checkpoint via follow_checkpoint._session_token(None), lines 65-82) that produced the resume event rendered as an unknown/unknown row.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 70d735ac..67beff6a is exactly reckon/cli.py, 12 insertions, 0 deletions, one file inside the declared path, with no test or unrelated module touched.
